critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py:15006 push_notify_overdue builds its own send-loop for THIS admin only and never calls _notify_company_admins. That means the manual 'Overdue overzicht' button does NOT broadcast an SSE to other admin tabs — unlike the daily job in _send_overdue_pushes which does. If a boekhouder presses the button, the owner tab won't update. Consider using _notify_company_admins for consistency.

/app/backend/server.py:10264 pending-approval push title uses US-format '{amount:,.2f}' ('SRD 1,000.00') instead of the Dutch helper _nl_money (would give 'SRD 1.000,00'). All other new notifications (kasgeld, quick plan, overdue) use _nl_money — inconsistent money formatting between notification types.

/app/backend/server.py:10066 kiosk login/logout notification body hard-codes Suriname offset UTC-3 via timezone(timedelta(hours=-3)) rather than a company-configured TZ. Harmless today but will drift if the SaaS adds non-SR tenants.

/app/backend/server.py:10052 _LOGOUT_GRACE_S = 90 is defined AFTER _kiosk_ws_employee uses it — Python resolves it at call-time so it works, but reads as a forward reference. Move the constant above the function for clarity.

/app/backend/server.py:14716 _notify_company_admins returns 0 if no admins exist and silently skips both SSE and push — but the SSE broadcast is already done before that check (good). Just a readability nit: the early-return comment above says 'SSE ALTIJD broadcasten' and it does, consistent.
